## Adding Markers {auto-animate=true}


- Specify latitude + longitude
- Popup option allows for interactive name


```{.r code-line-numbers="3-4"}
leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  addMarkers(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, popup = "Input coordinates to mark anything!")
```



## Adding Markers {auto-animate=true}



```{r}
leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  addMarkers(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, popup = "Input coordinates to mark anything!")
```



## Setting View {auto-animate=true}


- Specify location + zoom number to focus in...



```{.r code-line-numbers="3"}
leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, zoom = 20) |>
  addMarkers(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, popup = "Set view to show any zoom distance!")
 
```

## Changing Map Style {auto-animate=true}


- Use addProviderTiles function to change map appearance



```{.r code-line-numbers="4"}
leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, zoom = 5) |>
  addMarkers(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, popup = "Change map style using      addProviderTiles()!") |>
 addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap)
```




## Changing Map Style {auto-animate=true}




```{r}
leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, zoom = 5) |>
  addMarkers(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, popup = "Change map style using addProviderTiles()!") |>
 addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap)
```




::: footer
Possible Map Appearances!: [Leaflet Providers](https://leaflet-extras.github.io/leaflet-providers/preview/ )

## Changing Map Style {auto-animate=true}



```{r}
leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, zoom = 12) |>
  addMarkers(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, popup = "Change map style using addProviderTiles()!") |>
 addProviderTiles(providers$Stadia.StamenWatercolor)
```



## Multiple Markers  {auto-animate=true}

- Use c() function to show as many markers as you want!


```{.r code-line-numbers="3"}
leaflet() |>
  addMarkers(
    lng = c(-93.18184, -93.182811), lat = c(44.459161, 44.461883),
    popup = c("Regents Hall", "Buntrock Hall")
  ) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap) 
```




## Multiple Markers {auto-animate=true}




```{r}
leaflet() |>

    lng = c(-93.18184, -93.182811), lat = c(44.459161, 44.461883),
    popup = c("Regents Hall", "Buntrock Hall")
  ) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap) 
```



## Adding Shapes to Maps {auto-animate=true}


- Easy to add circles, rectangles, or any shape you want!



```{.r code-line-numbers="4-6"}
leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, zoom = 30) |>
addCircles(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, weight = 1,
    radius = 30
  )
```



## Adding Shapes to Maps {auto-animate=true}



```{r}
leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, zoom = 30) |>
addCircles(lng = -93.182811, lat =  44.461883, weight = 1,
    radius = 30
  )
```



## Adding Shapes to Maps {auto-animate=true}


- Easy to add circles, rectangles, or any shape you want!


```{.r code-line-numbers="3-7"}
leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |>
  addRectangles(
    lng1=-118.456554, lat1=34.078039,
    lng2=-118.436383, lat2=34.062717,
    fillColor = "transparent"
  )
```

## Using Data With Leaflet {auto-animate=true}


- Leaflet can use coordinate data with any factors you want
- For example: 


```{.r}
colleges <- data.frame(
  school = c(
    "Carleton College",
    "Macalester College",
    "Gustavus Adolphus College",
    "College of Saint Benedict",
    "Concordia College"
  ),
  lat = c(44.4623, 44.9367, 44.3238, 45.5586, 46.8594),
  long = c(-93.1547, -93.1699, -93.9758, -94.3190, -96.7656),
  size = c(2107, 2068, 1852, 1356, 1910)
)
```


```{r, echo = FALSE}
colleges <- data.frame(
  school = c(
    "Carleton College",
    "Macalester College",
    "Gustavus Adolphus College",
    "College of Saint Benedict",
    "Concordia College"
  ),
  lat = c(44.4623, 44.9367, 44.3238, 45.5586, 46.8594),
  long = c(-93.1547, -93.1699, -93.9758, -94.3190, -96.7656),
  size = c(2107, 2068, 1852, 1356, 1910)
)
```



## Using Data With Leaflet {auto-animate=true}


- Leaflet can use coordinate data with any factors you want
- For example: 



```{.r}
leaflet(colleges) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addMarkers(lng = ~long, lat = ~lat, popup = ~school)
```



## Using Data With Leaflet {auto-animate=true}




```{r}
leaflet(colleges) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addMarkers(lng = ~long, lat = ~lat, popup = ~school)
```



## Using Data With Leaflet {auto-animate=true}


- You can even map variables to shapes corresponding to a certain variable



```{.r}
# Show a circle at each position
leaflet(data = colleges) |>
   addTiles() |>
   addCircleMarkers(~long, ~lat , popup = ~school, radius = ~size*0.01)
```




## Using Data With Leaflet {auto-animate=true}




```{r}
# Show a circle at each position
leaflet(data = colleges) |>
   addTiles() |>
   addCircleMarkers(~long, ~lat , popup = ~school, radius = ~size*0.01)
```



## Using Data With Leaflet {auto-animate=true}


- Or you can map variables to a color palette and create a legend



```{.r}
  leaflet(colleges) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    ~long, ~lat,
    popup = ~school,
    radius = 10,
    color = ~colorNumeric(
      palette = "viridis",
      domain = size
    )(size),
    fillOpacity = 0.8
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = colorNumeric(
      palette = "viridis",
      domain = colleges$size
    ),
    values = ~size,
    title = "Student Population",
    opacity = 1
  )
```
